faq.a: The City of Chilliwack's 2050 Official Community Plan, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 — specifically its Schedule B3 Downtown Neighbourhood Plan, with the Schedule D-6 Downtown development permit area applying in the core and the other Schedule D areas applying per parcel.

faq.q: Which board's listings does this page show?
faq.a: Chilliwack is a Chilliwack and District Real Estate Board (CADREB) market, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only. The live page's FAQ claim that its listings update from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board feed is incorrect for a CADREB market and is flagged in this file as a rebuild fix.

Chilliwack is SD33, and the schools the live page names are confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file: Chilliwack Central Elementary Community (9435 Young Rd), Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Ave), Chilliwack Middle School (46354 Yale Rd) and Chilliwack Secondary (46363 Yale Rd) — but catchments are address-based and no SD33 locator result is on record in this program, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a downtown Chilliwack house add a suite?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, a secondary suite is one permitted accessory dwelling unit per lot, capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space, with garden suites capped at 100 m² and ADU parking at 1–2 spaces under s.5.04; the city-wide SSMUH amendment (Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024) allows 3–4 units on urban-growth-boundary parcels zoned for single-detached and duplex housing (see ~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, items 6 and 7f, read 2026-11-01).
